title: Grateful Dead Live at Dane County Coliseum on 1973-10-25
source: SBD MR > DAT > Sound Forge > CDR

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture with a monster Dark Star, only a brief glitch in Let It Grow.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for preserving the entire Dark Star without cuts and delivering a powerful, flowing jam that many fans rank among the top of the ’70s era. The soundboard source sounds clear overall, though listeners note an odd little splice in Let It Grow that adds a spooky moment. Aside from that hiccup, the show’s energy is high and the performance shines.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars and highlight an outstanding Dark Star; recording quality is good with only a minor glitch.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall sound; Dark Star left intact, but a small splice/cut appears in Let It Grow, noted as spooky by listeners.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows well with the highlight being a long Dark Star; inclusion of bonus tracks from an earlier show is appreciated.
